pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment: Heating sludge samples (50 ml) in oil baths at temperatures ranging from 110 °C to 150 °C for 20 min.
Alkaline pretreatment: Addition of 5 N Ca(OH)_2, KOH, or NaOH solutions to achieve a final pH ranging from 8 to 13, with continuous mixing for 1 h (individual) or 20 min (combined).
Ultrasonication: Applying 20 kHz ultrasound with 20% amplitude to 50 ml of WAS.
Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC): Forced fluid flow through an orifice plate with 27 holes of 1 mm diameter at around 0.7 and 0.07 MPa, resulting in cavitation generation and collapse.
Combined pretreatment: Combination of alkaline treatment (NaOH, KOH, or Ca(OH)_2) with hydrodynamic cavitation.
